mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs and higher corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by 0.5pp or more within a single month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 5% year-over-year growth in both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and housing market strength, compressing equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint 5% YoY growth in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 in a late-cycle economic regime signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle regimes (GDP growth > 2.5% and CPI > 2.0%), INDPRO below 95.0 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5 percentage points monthly increase from a 2.0% baseline indicates rising inflation expectations that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5pp or more within a single month.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals expanding labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue visibility, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 750 thousand units in a low-rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a synchronized housing boom and accommodative monetary policy that accelerates consumer spending and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS < 0.5% regimes, HOUST above 750 thousand units fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 and housing starts (HOUST) below 700 thousand units signal a broad-based economic slowdown across manufacturing and construction sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint INDPRO < 95.0 and HOUST < 700 thousand units fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
